forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,22 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8480'
+title: Make the two 8,192 constants tell apart in logs
+---
+## Problem
+
+`LiveModelLoader.responseTokenFloor` (the per-call output ceiling when a caller gives no `maxTokens`, `Resolution/LiveModelLoader.swift:189`) and `ProfileDefinition.defaultContext` (the context of a scripted test session) are both 8,192. A log line that says 8192 does not say which one it is. This sent an investigation after the wrong cause on 2026-09-22 (see ^46bz58k).
+
+## Do this
+
+1. Give the two values different numbers, or make each log line that prints one say which constant it is (for example `responseTokenFloor=8192`, `defaultContext=8192`).
+2. Do not change the resolved ceiling of a live session.
+
+## Acceptance
+
+- Each log line that prints one of the two values names the constant.
+- All tests pass with no change to their expected numbers, or with the expected numbers updated in the same commit.
+
+Requested by foundationmodelsacpagent-08. #compaction
\ No newline at end of file
